text:
I can't say whether this asset is deforestation-free, because the analysis didn't produce any result for it.

The land-change run (run-1, 12 Nov 2026) was set up with a 31 Dec 2020 baseline, a 30% tree-cover threshold and a 0.5 ha minimum event size. But the zonal statistics step failed. The tool reported that the source coverage this asset needs hasn't been prepared, so no observation was made. The asset area is also blank in the run metadata.

This is a data gap, not a clean result. No forest loss was detected, but that is because nothing was checked.

To get an answer, the source coverage for ASSET-K needs to be prepared and the run repeated. Until then, treat the asset's deforestation status as unassessed. Also note that the engine is labelled early access.
